label: Lauren Opal Boebert
narrative: Boebert sits on the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets and questioned witnesses at both the November 2024 and September 2025 hearings. Her 2024 round is worth preserving for two reasons. First, she answered Luna's 'you'll be on a list' warning by daring the surveillance apparatus outright before proceeding to name the program. Second, she asked all four witnesses, on the record, whether they were familiar with 'a secretive project within the Department of Defense involving the manipulation of human genetics with what is described as nonhuman genetic material potentially for the enhancement of human capabilities - hybrids.' All four - Gallaudet, Elizondo, Shellenberger and Gold - said no. That is a documented member-level rumour reaching the Hill and being tested under oath and coming back negative, which is exactly how the unverified layer should be handled. She also drew from Shellenberger the affirmative answer that Immaculate Constellation covers oceanic as well as terrestrial cases, and a flat 'Yes' to whether there is a concerted Pentagon effort to keep Congress out of the loop on UAP activity in US waters.
